blocks.text: AC circuits mein current ki mukhalfat impedance, Z, kehlati hai. Is mein resistance R, yani resistors ki mukhalfat, aur reactance X, yani capacitors (capacitive reactance XC) aur inductors (inductive reactance XL) ki mukhalfat, dono shamil hain. Sirf resistance wale circuit mein sirf resistance hoti hai, reactance nahi.

blocks.title: Impedance
blocks.text: Impedance AC circuit mein resistance aur reactances ka majmui asar hai. Yeh rms voltage aur rms current ka tanasub hai: Z = Vrms / Irms (17.20). Is ki SI ikai ohm hai.
Kyunke R, L aur C par voltages in phase nahi, resistance aur reactance seedhe jore nahi ja sakte. Inhein vectors (phasors) ki tarah jora jata hai, jaisa agle hisse dikhate hain.

AC circuit ka peak voltage 200 V aur peak current 10 A hai. Is ki impedance maloom karein. Hal: Vrms = 0.707 x 200 V = 141.4 V aur Irms = 0.707 x 10 A = 7.07 A, is liye Z = Vrms / Irms = 141.4 V / 7.07 A = 20 ohm. (Vo/Io = 200/10 se bhi yahi nateeja.)

blocks.prompt: Circuit ki impedance nikalne ke liye resistance aur reactance seedhe kyun nahi jore ja sakte?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke resistor aur reactance par voltages mein 90 darje ka phase farq hai; inhein vectors ki tarah jorna parta hai (R aur X ke liye Pythagoras se).

items: Impedance Z = Vrms / Irms: kul mukhalfat (R aur X) ohms mein.
R aur X vectors ki tarah jurte, adad ki tarah nahi.
